title: Predicting Body Mass Index From Structural MRI Brain Images Using a Deep Convolutional Neural Network.
summary: A deep convolutional network predicted body-mass index from structural brain MRI, reporting held-out prediction and image-feature associations; the result is a specific brain-imaging/phenotype association.
